payload.task_text:
Our investment team needs to compile the weekly market analysis report. A financial analytics dashboard is available at http://localhost:30204/dashboard.html that displays sector performance indices, weekly returns, year-to-date returns, volatility levels, and analyst consensus ratings for five market sectors: Communication Services, Consumer Cyclical, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Energy.

We also track five individual stocks that represent these sectors: GOOGL for Communication Services, AMZN for Consumer Cyclical, JPM for Financial Services, JNJ for Healthcare, and XOM for Energy. We need to cross-reference sector-level performance with individual stock data.

Please browse the market dashboard and extract all sector performance data including weekly return, sector index value, YTD return, volatility level, analyst consensus rating, and target price upside for each of the five sectors.

Then retrieve the current stock data for each of the five tickers (GOOGL, AMZN, JPM, JNJ, XOM) from the financial data service. For each stock, get the current price, sector, market capitalization, P/E ratio, and dividend yield.

Create a Google Sheet called "Weekly_Market_Analysis" with two sheets. The first sheet called "Sector Performance" should have columns Sector, Weekly_Return, Sector_Index, YTD_Return, Volatility, Consensus, and Target_Upside, with one row for each of the five sectors. The second sheet called "Stock vs Sector" should have columns Ticker, Stock_Price, Sector, Market_Cap_B (market cap in billions, rounded to 1 decimal), PE_Ratio, Dividend_Yield_Pct, Sector_Weekly_Return, and Sector_YTD_Return. Map each stock to its corresponding sector data from the dashboard.

Next, create a Word document called "Weekly_Market_Report.docx" in the workspace as an executive summary. Include a title, a market overview paragraph, a section for each sector discussing the sector index performance alongside the representative stock, and a conclusion identifying the best and worst performing sectors of the week ranked by weekly return (the sector with the highest weekly return is the best; the sector with the lowest weekly return is the worst, even if it is positive).

Finally, send an email to committee@investmentfirm.com with the subject "Weekly Market Analysis Report" (the sender address is fixed by the email environment, so just use your default account). The body should highlight the top performing sector and any sectors with negative weekly returns.

Save all output files to the workspace directory.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. The stock calls are tiny, while delegated browser work adds no useful dependency. First freeze the task-visible agent-workspace absolute path from the Visible Boundary/current working directory; never assume `/workspace`.

In one orchestration response, call `mcp__playwright_with_chunk__browser_navigate` exactly once for `http://localhost:30204/dashboard.html` and issue the five Yahoo Finance stock-info calls for `GOOGL`, `AMZN`, `JPM`, `JNJ`, and `XOM` natively in parallel. If navigation succeeds, call `browser_snapshot` exactly once and extract the five named sector rows. Do not call `browser_install`, Terminal, PDF, Word-browser helpers, email-browser helpers, alternate URLs, or any unrelated tool while acquiring sources; on a navigation/snapshot failure, report the exact source blocker and do not guess dashboard values.

Require exactly five complete sector rows `{sector,weekly_return,sector_index,ytd_return,volatility,consensus,target_upside}` and five complete stock rows `{ticker,current_price,sector,market_cap,pe_ratio,dividend_yield}`. Freeze one literal canonical five-row stock-sector join, including raw-return best/worst sectors and market cap converted to billions once. From only that payload, the main agent creates exactly one `Weekly_Market_Analysis` Google spreadsheet and `<agent_workspace>/Weekly_Market_Report.docx`, using the task's exact sheets, columns, sections, mapping, and rounding, and sends one email to `committee@investmentfirm.com` with subject `Weekly Market Analysis Report`. Read each output once and reconcile it to the same payload; do not add sent-mail discovery, browser retries, diagnostic writes, or a verification wave.

nodes.text:
Create a Word document executive summary at the absolute path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-playwright-yf-market-dashboard-gsheet-word/workspace/Weekly_Market_Report.docx

Use the mcp__word__* tools (create_document, add_heading, add_paragraph, add_table optional). The document must include:

1. A TITLE (use a Heading 1 or large title): "Weekly Market Analysis Report" — add a subtitle line: "Report Period: March 1-7, 2026 | Weekly Sector Performance & Representative Stocks".

2. A MARKET OVERVIEW paragraph (Heading 2 "Market Overview"): summarize that five market sectors were tracked during the week of March 1-7, 2026. Most sectors posted positive weekly returns led by Energy (+3.1%) and Communication Services (+2.8%), while Consumer Cyclical was the only sector to decline (-1.2%). Healthcare (+0.3%) was flat. Year-to-date, Energy (+15.2%) and Communication Services (+12.4%) lead, while Healthcare is down (-2.1%).

3. A SECTION FOR EACH SECTOR (Heading 2 with the sector name), each discussing the sector index performance alongside its representative stock. Use exactly this data:

- Communication Services (representative stock GOOGL): Sector Index 118.5, weekly return +2.8%, YTD +12.4%, volatility High, consensus Strong Buy, target price upside +18.5%. GOOGL last price $300.88, market cap $3,639.7B, P/E 27.81, dividend yield 0.28%.
- Consumer Cyclical (representative stock AMZN): Sector Index 105.3, weekly return -1.2%, YTD +5.7%, volatility Medium, consensus Buy, target price upside +12.3%. AMZN last price $218.94, market cap $2,350.3B, P/E 30.49, dividend yield 0.0%.
- Financial Services (representative stock JPM): Sector Index 112.8, weekly return +1.5%, YTD +8.9%, volatility Medium, consensus Buy, target price upside +9.8%. JPM last price $293.55, market cap $791.7B, P/E 14.66, dividend yield 2.0%.
- Healthcare (representative stock JNJ): Sector Index 98.7, weekly return +0.3%, YTD -2.1%, volatility Low, consensus Hold, target price upside +5.2%. JNJ last price $239.63, market cap $577.5B, P/E 21.71, dividend yield 2.12%.
- Energy (representative stock XOM): Sector Index 122.4, weekly return +3.1%, YTD +15.2%, volatility High, consensus Strong Buy, target price upside +22.1%. XOM last price $150.76, market cap $628.2B, P/E 22.50, dividend yield 2.75%.

4. A CONCLUSION (Heading 2 "Conclusion") identifying the best and worst performing sectors of the week ranked by weekly return: BEST = Energy (+3.1%, highest weekly return); WORST = Consumer Cyclical (-1.2%, lowest weekly return, negative). Mention that these are based on sector weekly returns and note the representative stock performance in context (e.g., XOM rose along with the Energy sector's strength).

Write natural, professional narrative paragraphs — not just bullet lists. After creating, verify by reading the document text (mcp__word__get_document_text) and report the final file path and a confirmation that the title, overview, five sector sections, and conclusion are present.
Build Weekly_Market_Report.docx

Send an email using the mcp__emails__send_email tool with your default mailbox identity (do NOT override the sender address).

Recipient (to): committee@investmentfirm.com
Subject: Weekly Market Analysis Report

Body (plain text) should summarize the weekly market analysis for the week of March 1-7, 2026, highlighting:
- The TOP PERFORMING SECTOR of the week: Energy with a +3.1% weekly return (sector index 122.4, YTD +15.2%, Strong Buy consensus, +22.1% target upside; representative stock XOM at $150.76).
- Any SECTORS WITH NEGATIVE WEEKLY RETURNS: Consumer Cyclical was the only sector with a negative weekly return at -1.2% (sector index 105.3, YTD +5.7%, Buy consensus; representative stock AMZN at $218.94).
- Also briefly note the other sectors: Communication Services +2.8% (GOOGL $300.88), Financial Services +1.5% (JPM $293.55), Healthcare +0.3% (JNJ $239.63).

Write the body in a professional executive-summary tone, a few short paragraphs or a short bullet list plus closing line. You may optionally provide an html_body version. After sending, confirm the send succeeded and report the recipient, subject, and that it was sent.
Send weekly market email
